maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes mainly from Epic Pass, lift tickets, ski school, dining and lodging at owned resorts, not repair or servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are consumers and vacationers buying passes, lift tickets, lessons, lodging and retail; not government-funded.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth mainly from pass sales and resort investment; acquisitions like Crans-Montana are occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Skiers can easily choose other resorts or passes; leisure travel, though Epic Pass holders have some loyalty.
